title.en: The Witness is finally on iOS!

subtitle.en: After nearly a year of optimization, the full game is out on iOS for $9.99.
subtitle.zh: 经过将近一年的优化，完整版游戏已登陆 iOS，售价 $9.99。

translator.note: 原文里受支持的机型是四个独立行、没有 bullet 标记，这里按列表（list）处理。

blocks.en: In case you haven't heard the news, after nearly a year of optimizing, refining touch-controls, etc., we finally released The Witness on iOS!
blocks.zh: 万一你还没听说这个消息：在将近一年的优化、打磨触控操作等等之后，我们终于把《The Witness》发布到 iOS 上了！

blocks.en: You can find it on the App Store, and carry around the full game in your pocket...which is pretty crazy if you ask me.
blocks.zh: 你可以在 App Store 上找到它，把完整版游戏装进口袋随身带着……要我说，这挺疯狂的。
